AgriField-40K duplicate review pack

784 candidate edges from data/duplicate_pairs.csv, covering 963 distinct images. All 512x512 images were centre-cropped square and resized to 160px for this sheet (1568 thumbnails written, 0 failed). Works offline.

Every row starts at pending_manual_review. Nothing in this pack is a confirmed duplicate. A hash distance is a screening signal, not proof. Tick a verdict per row and write it back to data/duplicate_review.csv (see reports/duplicate_review_protocol.md).

A. Cross-split candidates (train <-> val) (247) B. Manifest-affecting candidates (one endpoint in an include manifest) (11) C. Same-split screening candidates (526)
Exact byte-identical pairs (kind=sha256) are certain duplicates. kind=perceptual_candidate means pHash Hamming ≤4 and dHash Hamming ≤6, which is a two-screener rule chosen to reduce false hits on visually uniform field scenes. It still produces false positives, which is exactly what this review exists to resolve.

A. Cross-split candidates (train <-> val) (247)

These pairs straddle the original train/validation split. If they are real duplicates they are a direct leakage path between pretraining and validation. Review these first.
